attention_ecology.evidence_weight: Conservative Spider edge weight; replay does not create new evidence.
attention_ecology.attention_weight: Volatile discovery priority. Repeated patterns can rise enough to be inspected, then replay fatigue lowers stale patterns.
attention_ecology.node_attention: Dynamic A_t(v) focus over graph nodes, propagated through bounded spiral rings.

pippi_binding.cycle_rule: After exact replay, PIPPI appends the pass. Spider chunks/relations and the canonical TOPA attention ecology are then reflected into PIPPI Mirror. Pivot-Slime and Keymaster read that mirror before the next pass.

canonical_cycle: 0. PIPPI opens with previous exact/accounting mirror and previous attention ecology.
1. JUXTAPOSE/Exact JANUS exposes exact route receipts.
2. M2R-PM stores exact experience and retrieves structural neighbors.
3. JGPT Teacher learns exact-backed route/resource targets.
5. Spider weaves relations and runs bounded spiral attention over active data/PIPPI chunks.
6. Repeated patterns gain temporary discovery salience; stale replay saturates and loses attention; fresh evidence can renew it.
7. TOPA CORE attacks relation/attention interpretations for confounding, replay inflation and unsupported causality.
8. Keymaster ranks routes using exact memory, JGPT/Slime proposals, surviving Detective context, current cap and previous PIPPI mirror.
9. Exact JANUS replay alone decides fit/overflow/terminal/proof semantics.
10. PIPPI appends exact result, resource spend, learning cost and checkpoint metadata.
11. Spider re-chunks affected PIPPI history, updates relation weights and dynamic attention centers.
12. TOPA CORE falsifies newly salient relations/focus interpretations.
13. PIPPI Mirror records EXACT_FACT / DETECTIVE_HYPOTHESIS / TOPA_REJECTED / UNKNOWN plus attention ecology.
14. Pivot-Slime and Keymaster look in the mirror before the next pass to see what improved, what wasted work, what saturated, and where attention migrated.
15. Mirror context may reorder exploration only; exact/source evidence remains truth authority.
ecosystem_interpretation: The loop behaves like a bounded information ecosystem: recurring patterns consume attention long enough to be examined, stale repetition loses energy, fresh evidence can reactivate a pattern, and freed attention flows to other graph regions. This is a search-control metaphor and implementation policy, not a biological or truth claim.
